newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slump in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slump in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slumped in early Thursday morning trade, depressed by weakness in U.S. markets overnight, brokers said. They added however that trade was extremely thin as market participants were awaiting the March futures and options settlement on Friday.
As of 0022 GMT, the Nikkei average was down 169.59 points, or 0.93 percent, at 18,013.68. Its March futures were down 110 points at 18,020 and June was 90 points lower at 17,960.
"There's is no new upsetting news," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said. "Bargain hunting should set in to prop (the Nikkei) up should it fall below the 18,000."
